title: Students onboarded through a school code without verified guardian consent

text: Internal audit: 63 accounts aged 13-17 joined with the school join code OOW-G11; the guardian e-mail OTP step was skipped by a bug in the school onboarding path. Their timetables and grades are being synced from the school connector.

rationale: Matched tags ['consent_unverified', 'minor_data'] to my mandate; actions are taken from my rule table and each is grounded in the best-matching excerpt from my sources.

actions.action: Treat the records as children's data: restrict access to the minimum staff needed and stop any non-essential processing of them.
Suspend processing for the affected accounts until consent is verified; re-run guardian verification; keep proof of each consent.

gaps.title: No statutory clock for notifying a breach of children's data
Education platforms may be exempted from the under-13 data rule by a resolution that does not exist yet
Teenagers' consent is not addressed by the PDPL
The same AI tutor falls under different data-protection regimes depending on who deploys it
Several regulators can claim a children's-data AI incident; none is named lead
